time_fields.semantic_available_at: the official publication event of the target race beforeinfo in which the previous-race value is printed
time_fields.physical_capture_at: timestamp at which the exact official target-race beforeinfo artifact was fetched and hashed
time_fields.prior_race_finish_at: time the earlier race finished/settled; may be null when not independently timestamped
time_fields.target_prediction_cutoff: after target official beforeinfo acquisition and strictly before closed_at

decision_logic.timestamp_confirmed: all predicates pass and physical_capture_at <= target_prediction_cutoff
decision_logic.semantic_confirmed: all identity/order predicates pass; exact field is printed in the official target beforeinfo; official page semantics and artifact hash are audited, even if historical physical capture is later
decision_logic.semantic_candidate: field is printed in target beforeinfo but publication/capture provenance is incomplete; quarantine until manual/audit confirmation
decision_logic.insufficient: any identity, order, source-page, or cutoff predicate fails

feature_use_rule: Only timestamp_confirmed or separately approved semantic_confirmed rows may enter a future as-of snapshot. semantic_candidate/insufficient rows remain null with a reason code.
prior_race_finish_time_fallback: If prior_race_finish_at is unavailable, do not join a final result table. The value may only be a semantic_candidate based on its presence in the target-race official beforeinfo, pending provenance audit.
reason: no same-day feature was materialized; policy forbids direct result joins
